review.use_summary: Reported Spyrrow0.1 commu.cn.call under Python3.10.5 for neighborhood ligand–receptor activity using combined interaction resources. Also used Spyrrow plot_cell_patch for cell-boundary images and plot_RNA_on_cell for transcript overlays restricted to selected cell states. Communication-result visualization used ggplot2 separately.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paper does not identify an exact commit, coordinate scaling, threshold or complete function arguments. Retain both communication and plotting roles; do not label generic Java square-root scoring as the full tool. Captured0.1 source18cf78611c22 has an unguarded cn import-time nam failure and a pickle database loader. Native communication-component controls do not admit that wrapper, its database, either plotting API, historical Python3.10.5 behavior or a paper replay.
